needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Unbooked since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest inventory in that market — a refundable hold placed now costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sept 30 and book-by Oct 15 has passed; three weeks with all four girls over the holidays is the year's thinnest inventory, and every day narrows it.
